The Modern Azure Journey: Where Data Meets AI (Data → Intelligence → Experience) Extending Existing Azure Databricks Investments with Microsoft Fabric, Fabric IQ & Microsoft Foundry — Zero Data Duplication

ADLS Gen2
Azure Databricks Existing Enterprise Data Estate

Open APIs

Bidirectional Interoperability Mirrored UC & OneLake Federation
